name: Warlock: Demon Claws strikes twice with a single weapon (#8389)
contract: Demon Claws 217364 advertises 'Strike twice, dealing ... Physical damage per strike' with two TRIGGER_SPELL_WITH_VALUE effects: 281295 requires a main-hand weapon (AttributesEx3 0x400) and 281296 requires an off-hand weapon (0x1000000). Without a second weapon only the main-hand strike landed, so a two-hander or a lone one-hander dealt one strike. When the off-hand equipment slot is empty, the cast repeats the main-hand strike 281295 once, so the advertised two strikes land.

steps.label: SETUP: the two-handed staff occupies the main hand
DISCRIMINATING: two main-hand strikes land without an off-hand weapon
CONTROL: the off-hand-only strike did not fire
